snippet.title: KilaFlow | FWA Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST KILAFLOW TODAY: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2927510/KilaFlow/

Like the music? Listen to and buy the KilaFlow: Swipe Right EP HERE: https://rettjester.bandcamp.com/album/kilaflow-swipe-right-ep

KilaFlow is a high speed percision 3d platformer that will be available on steam in July 2025! Play as a digital Antivirus robot helping their creator save various programs and devices from a mysterious computer virus, traveling to many colorful and abstract worlds reflecting the program you're helping!
